{{Quote|Our combined strength will be rewarded. Mandalore will be yours, and Kenobi, this Sith pretender Dooku and all our enemies&hellip; will fall.|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] to [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]|<ref name="Eminence (episode)">{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Shadow Collective''' was a criminal organization founded during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Maul rallied the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] to his cause first, then the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] faction, and lastly several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] enforcers.

==History==
Maul and his [[Brother/Legends|brother]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] were found near dead in their escape pod above [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. The two were found by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan]] of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], and taken to their camp on [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]] for treatment. After discussing their views and finding a similar enemy in [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the brothers allied with Vizsla and the Death Watch. From there, they embarked on a [[Mission to Mustafar (Death Watch)/Legends|mission]] to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] where they went to meet with [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]]. When the latter and his four other leaders refused to join the new collective, Opress [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber throw|hurled]] his [[Savage Opress's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at him which [[Death/Legends|killed]] him. His underling and [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]], [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]], joined Maul and his allies after he witnessed the manner in which his boss and his four leaders were killed.

In addition, [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]] and his allies ventured to visit Maul on Zanbar and he joined when he learned that Maul was forming an [[Army/Legends|army]]. After that, they immediately set course for [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. They [[Mission to Nal Hutta/Legends|traveled]] to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and met with the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] refused, and they were forced to retreat from several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]] was killed by Savage Opress after revealing that the other Hutts were holed up in [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After a [[Attack on Jabba's Palace/Legends|brief skirmish]] at the palace, the Hutt decided to assist the collective and provided several Hutt enforcers. Following the skirmish, Vizsla personally spoke with Bo-Katan and promised that [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] would be theirs and the two brothers would be dead, like the [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Duchess]].

[[File:PykeSyndicate-Eminence.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]]]]
In the days that followed, Maul's collective successfully assisted the Death Watch in the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|Takeover of Mandalore]]. Maul's plan involved turning the Death Watch from criminals into heroes for the people, without whom it would be impossible to control Mandalore. Maul's agents attacked police forces in [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] to show the weakness of the [[Duke/Legends|Duchess's]] [[New Mandalorians/Legends|government]]. Duchess Satine Kryze attempted to calm her people outside the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|palace]], but Vizsla and the Death Watch then swooped in and intervened to "stop" the criminals, becoming heroes in the eyes of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] people who started calling for change. Kryze would be imprisoned, and eventually killed by Maul as revenge against Obi-Wan Kenobi, Satine's former lover and Maul's nemesis.

Vizlsa deployed squads to stop the criminals and had Ziton Moj, Lom Pyke and Savage Opress arrested. Maul was soon betrayed by Vizsla who had him imprisoned, but the two soon broke out of prison with former Prime Minister Almec and they confronted Vizsla. In a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], Maul killed Vizsla and proclaimed himself [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] and the leader of the Death Watch. Bo-Katan and her [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]] refused to join and fled. Maul would then have his soldiers repaint their armor [[Color/Legends|red]].

Soon after, the Shadow Collective would face the Nite Owls in battle. But the renegades would team up with Obi-Wan Kenobi. The two Sith Lords, meanwhile, dueled with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] when he came to the palace to deal with the brothers personally. In the duel, Sidious managed to kill Opress when he [[Shiak|impaled]] him on his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], and he subdued Maul with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].
